selectChatPrompt.text: Select a channel or node to start messaging.

signed.label: Signed message
signed.tooltip: Signed by the sender (XEdDSA) and verified by your radio.

valid.label: Delivery proven
valid.tooltip: Delivery proven: the recipient's acknowledgement carried a valid proof of receipt.

invalid.label: Forged acknowledgement
invalid.description: The acknowledgement for this message failed its proof check. It may have been forged, so the message may not have been delivered.
